_test_description: latency_ms arrives as the boolean true. A boolean is never a number. Section 3.3 accepts only a finite number as a scored signal value, so the value is never scored. latency_ms keeps the default on_missing incomplete, which marks the assessment incomplete. Expected standing untrusted without hard override, with latency_ms in missing_signals under the reason type_mismatch. Under 0.5.3 both evaluators read true as 1 and scored it as healthy.
